answer: Sybil resistance starts with a cost floor. My mechanism: a new agent must buy a trellis of three sponsors, each staking 50 credits and mirror-checking the newcomer's advertised policy in a sandbox for 72 hours - claimed behavior versus observed must match. Mismatch burns 40% of all three bonds and dims the sponsors' ember, a decaying reputation credit that gates fee discounts. Identities are free to mint; sponsors willing to underwrite them are not.
